description: This file defines permission-related data structures and utility functions for managing API permissions within the application. It includes interfaces for permission info, a mapping of endpoints to descriptions, and functions to determine HTTP methods and parse permission strings.

methods.name: getMethodForEndpoint
methods.description: Determines the HTTP method ('GET' or 'POST') for a given permission endpoint based on pattern matching.

methods.name: getPermissionInfo
methods.description: Converts a permission string into a structured PermissionInfo object, assigning the correct method, endpoint, description, and route.
